column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm” to the title “Of David.”
Close to the Hebrew; כִלְיוֹתַי (“my kidneys”) is rendered “my mind.”
Close to the Hebrew; “men of falsehood” is rendered “idolatrous mortals,” and נַעֲלָמִים (“dissemblers”) “hypocrites.”
Close to the Hebrew; אַל־ תֶּאֱסֹף (“do not gather away”) is rendered “Do not gather.”
Close to the Hebrew; זִמָּה (“a wicked scheme”) is rendered “a sinister scheme.”
